title: Speaking — Things worth walking for
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on things worth walking for.

questions: What do you like about the room you use most?
Is there a part of your home you rarely use?
How long have you lived in your current home?
What would you put in a room of your own?
How often do you walk to do everyday errands?
What makes a walk more pleasant for you?

part2.topic: Describe a walk that showed you a useful feature of your area.
part2.closing: and explain what made the discovery worth the walk.

questions: How can local businesses benefit from better walking routes?
Which safety measures make the biggest difference to pedestrians?
How has everyday life connected with things worth walking for changed for people of different ages?
